items.title: mnh-jansson/open-battery-information
items.description: Open Battery Information provides Arduino and Python/Windows tools and battery data to help inspect and repair locked battery management systems (C++ · ⭐ 1588).

items.title: remontsuri/EV-QA-Framework
items.description: ML-powered Python framework for EV battery health monitoring, anomaly detection, SOH prediction, and compliance testing with CAN bus support (Python · ⭐ 7).

items.title: OpenEVSE/openevse_esp32_firmware
items.description: ESP32-based WiFi gateway for OpenEVSE chargers with web dashboard, OCPP 1.6-J integration, solar divert, and energy management (C · ⭐ 228).

items.title: lachand/EV_charger
items.description: Home Assistant integration providing local LAN control of Tuya EV chargers without cloud connectivity (Python · ⭐ 11).

items.title: OpenEMS/openems
items.description: OpenEMS is an open-source, modular energy management platform with distributed Edge and cloud Backend components for monitoring, controlling, and integrating renewable energy, storage, and EV charging (Java · ⭐ 1479).

items.title: SolarNetwork/solarnetwork-central
items.description: A cloud platform for the SolarNetwork system that manages user accounts, provisions IoT nodes, and provides REST APIs for accessing energy monitoring data from distributed nodes (Java · ⭐ 7).

items.title: SAFE-eV/OCMF-Open-Charge-Metering-Format
items.description: The Open Charge Metering Format (OCMF) specification for EV charging metering data, maintained collaboratively as markdown within the SAFE Group (⭐ 32).

items.title: etalab/schema-irve
items.description: TableSchema specification for standardizing static and dynamic data (location, technical specifications, operational status, availability) of French EV charging infrastructure (Elixir · ⭐ 12).

items.title: charinev/unified-error-codes
items.description: A draft specification standardizing error codes and diagnostics across the entire EV charging ecosystem, developed by CharIN e.V.'s Charging Communication Subgroup (Python · ⭐ 9).

items.title: unified-error-codes/specification
items.description: Specification for unified error codes to standardize error reporting and diagnostics across the EV charging ecosystem, developed by CharIN (Python · ⭐ 4).

Contributions are welcome! If you know of a tool or resource that is not on the list, please feel free to add it.
The easiest way to contribute is to open an issue using the "Add a link" template.
You can also submit a pull request. Note that the project listing above is generated — descriptions and categories are edited in , not by hand in this file. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full workflow.
